issues: Is s. 44(3) of the DPDP Act, which narrowed the RTI Act's exemption for personal information, constitutional?
Are ss. 17, 33 and 36 of the Act, and the rules for selecting the Data Protection Board, valid?
Does the Act need an exemption for journalism?
timeline: The RTI petitions are referred to a larger bench.
Notice issued on the Digital News Publishers Association's petition; interim stay declined without hearing the Union.
Listed with the connected petitions but not taken up; adjourned to 9 December.

digital-arrest.bench: Surya Kant CJI, Joymalya Bagchi J, V. Mohana J
issues: What must banks and the RBI do to stop money moving to fraud accounts?
When must a bank compensate a victim who was tricked into sending the money?
What must WhatsApp and other platforms do to prevent these scams?
timeline: The Supreme Court takes suo motu cognisance on a complaint by a senior-citizen couple from Ambala, Haryana.
The Court orders a pan-India CBI probe, including into the alleged role of bank officials.
The Court calls the frauds "robbery or dacoity" and asks the Centre to draft SOPs with the RBI and others, and to work out a compensation framework.
The RBI is directed to adopt, within four weeks, an SOP for banks to place temporary debit holds on accounts linked to cyber fraud.
The Court says the RBI's new rules must make banks compensate victims where a failure of due diligence enabled the fraud, and asks WhatsApp and other intermediaries for their prevention plans.
Listed again; the outcome has not been reported yet.
extra_sources: Fox Mandal note on the 29 Oct order

issues: Are AI-generated videos and images of the Delhi Chief Minister, posted by a political party, protected satire or defamation?
Should the posts stay down until the suit is decided?
timeline: Interim order: six URLs directed to be taken down; summons issued.

ani-openai.case_no: Appeal against the order of 24 July 2026 in CS(COMM) 1028/2024
issues: Is training ChatGPT on ANI's news content fair dealing for research under s. 52 of the Copyright Act?
Was the single judge right to refuse ANI an interim injunction?
timeline: The single judge refuses ANI an interim injunction.
A Division Bench issues notice on ANI's appeal; no interim direction.

issues: Does letting sellers bid on the well-known mark KENT as a sponsored-ads keyword infringe it?
Can Amazon claim intermediary safe harbour for keyword advertising?
timeline: Summons issued on Kent's application for an ad interim injunction; Amazon accepts notice. No interim relief granted.

issues: How can children be protected from online sexual exploitation without banning them from the internet?
Are the Centre and platforms carrying out the Court's 15 October directions?
timeline: Order: internet access is a fundamental right for children too; blanket age-based bans are disproportionate. Directions on a child mode, a national hash database, faster takedowns and fines scaled to platform size.

issues: Can a revenue order in a land dispute, allegedly passed ex parte with AI tools and without verifying facts, stand?
What action does the State propose to take?
timeline: The Jangaon Collector passes the order under challenge.
The High Court suspends the order and issues notice to the Revenue Principal Secretary, the Collector and the Tahsildar.
Listed; the outcome has not been reported yet.

issues: May police use facial recognition on people at designated protest sites without a law authorising it?
timeline: Notice issued on SFLC.in's petition, tagged with A.A. Rahim's earlier plea on the July Jantar Mantar protests.

gaming.bench: Bench led by the Chief Justice
issues: Can Parliament ban all online money games, including games of skill, under the Online Gaming Act, 2025?
timeline: The Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 comes into force.
The Court agrees to a final hearing; no interim stay.

issues: Must an Indian advertiser's suit over disabled ad accounts be heard in California under Meta's terms?
timeline: The court refuses Meta's application: claims under the IT Act and IT Rules need an Indian forum.

issues: When will the Data Protection Board's Chairperson and Members be appointed?
timeline: The Board is established in law.
The Kerala High Court records that the Board is not functional.
Consent manager registration opens.
Most DPDP Act duties take effect.

sarthak.short: Sarthak Bhagat v. Union of India
timeline: Writ held not maintainable against Meta; the GAC directed to decide the appeal quickly.
SP's notice held to be without jurisdiction; the page ordered restored (date reported).

anmol.short: Anmol Jain v. Union of India
timeline: Challenge to Rule 3(1)(b)(iv) dismissed.
₹425 crore penalty set aside and sent back to a different officer.

pooja.short: Pooja Ramesh Singh v. J&K Bank
timeline: NCLT and NCLAT orders set aside; citing unverified AI-generated precedents held to be professional misconduct.
